tldr: Three zero-days are under active exploitation right now — N-able N-central (even on the "patched" Hotfix 2), Windows CLFS ("SignDrop"), and Xen Orchestra — alongside fresh breaches at ConnectWise ScreenConnect-managed MSPs, shipping giant Maersk, and Notion (via AI vendor Fireworks AI). A mass GitHub credential-theft campaign and a critical Apache HTTP Server RCE round out a busy 48 hours.

emerging.title: Autonomous AI Attack Framework Hits Semiconductor, Defense, Civil Society Targets
emerging.description: Unit 42 uncovered "Cairn," used by a China-nexus actor to let an AI agent independently run 25 intrusion attempts against 19 organizations, breaching 10 with minimal human oversight — among the first documented large-scale autonomous AI attack campaigns.

emerging.title: Kazakhstan-Linked Hackers Used an AI Agent to Spy on Central Asian Governments
emerging.description: A Kazakhstan-linked threat actor deployed an AI agent to automate reconnaissance and espionage against regional government targets, another sign state-aligned groups are operationalizing agentic AI for intrusion work.

items.title: N-able N-central Zero-Day Exploited Even on "Patched" Servers
items.description: Attackers are exploiting N-central RMM flaws within hours of a PoC release; 21 servers compromised, 19 of them already on Hotfix 2, giving root/SYSTEM access on an MSP-critical platform.

items.title: New Windows CLFS "SignDrop" Zero-Day Grants SYSTEM Privileges
items.description: A newly disclosed Windows CLFS zero-day lets attackers escalate to SYSTEM access; confirmed under active exploitation by two outlets, with no official Microsoft patch yet available.

items.title: Critical Xen Orchestra Flaws Exploited in Attacks
items.description: Attackers are actively exploiting critical vulnerabilities in Xen Orchestra, the popular virtualization management platform, putting hypervisor infrastructure at risk; admins should patch immediately. (Single-sourced.)

items.title: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Breaches Hit Dozens of MSPs
items.description: New worm-like "SCKit" malware is abusing ScreenConnect remote-support sessions to pivot into MSP networks; ConnectWise is investigating incidents at nearly 50 organizations.

items.title: Maersk Confirms Data Theft Amid $5 Million Extortion Attempt
items.description: Shipping giant Maersk confirmed attackers stole data from a legacy system and are demanding $5 million; the WhiteArmor ransomware group claims responsibility.

items.title: Notion Customer Data Exposed via Fireworks AI Supply-Chain Hack
items.description: A breach at AI infrastructure vendor Fireworks AI exposed Notion customer data, including AI chat content — a reminder of growing supply-chain risk from third-party AI providers embedded in mainstream SaaS.

items.title: Mass GitHub Credential-Theft Campaign Hits Thousands of Repos
items.description: A threat actor hijacked thousands of GitHub accounts (reports range from ~4,837 accounts/1,800+ repos to a target list of 60,000) to run malicious CI workflows stealing cloud credentials.

items.title: Critical Apache HTTP Server RCE Patched
items.description: Apache patched a critical unauthenticated RCE in mod_http2 (CVE-2026-119618), discovered by Anthropic and Google, affecting one of the world's most-used web servers; update now before public exploitation emerges.

items.title: European Authorities Take Down Stealc Malware Infrastructure Again
items.description: European law enforcement dismantled Stealc info-stealer servers for the second time this year, though the malware-as-a-service operation has rebuilt quickly after prior takedowns. (Single-sourced.)

items.title: Poland Shuts Down Government Services Platform After Cyberattack
items.description: Poland took its ePUAP government services platform offline following a cyberattack, disrupting citizen access to official digital services; the incident remains under investigation. (Single-sourced.)

action: Isolate or restrict access to N-able N-central immediately — exploitation succeeds even against the Hotfix 2 "patched" state; watch for Microsoft guidance on the Windows CLFS SignDrop zero-day and restrict its attack surface meanwhile; patch Xen Orchestra and Apache HTTP Server (mod_http2, CVE-2026-119618) now; audit ScreenConnect/RMM session logs for MSP-related compromise indicators; rotate any GitHub Actions/CI secrets potentially exposed in the mass account-hijacking campaign.
